title: Lock Picking
description: Test your timing and precision to pick the locks.
about:
Lock Picking is a browser game where you click the spinning lock when the moving pointer aligns with its target. Clear all stages without missing.

Start a round in your browser and use the controls below to play.
howToPlay: Click the spinning lock when the moving pointer aligns with its target. Clear all stages without missing.
tips: Use click / tap the lock to try the current alignment.
Try another round to practice the timing and strategy.

faq.question: How do I play Lock Picking?
faq.answer: Click the spinning lock when the moving pointer aligns with its target. Clear all stages without missing.

faq.question: Can I play Lock Picking in a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the game page and play without installing an app.
